review.title: Rumen enrichment, Prymnesium stocks and Black Soil term: scoped reference correspondences
review.independence_basis: Independent peers read all three complete source contexts, primary passages and bound native outcomes, then every actual M5 candidate diff and captured input. A separate peer accepted each actual application/history configuration. The unchanged source binder, guarded writer, checker and diagnostic builder retain their previously reviewed controls. This is self-review of the resulting technical corrections, with independent review of the actual diagnostic before native save.
review.summary: Thirty-one selected descriptor occurrences receive twenty-nine native reference blocks, two complete ambiguity lists and thirty-one statuses across three whole records. All stock identities, historical notes, biological assertions and scientific holds remain unchanged. The Rhodanobacter update is explicitly term-only and does not establish the unresolved Black Soil SynCom membership.
review.scope_description: Three whole-record technical units: CommunityMech:000389, CommunityMech:000381 and CommunityMech:000482. Scope is limited to the selected database correspondence fields, six native inline events, three history sidecars and actual source/application/gate provenance. Partial coverage and scientific_review:false remain mandatory.
review.selection: The three remaining independently source-reviewed units after the complete 441 canary. The completed 441 diagnostic is separate and is not included in these target or check counts. Each current record retains its full original scientific content and unresolved limitations.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Scoped native passes do not establish a complete scientific review, measured quotation coverage, generated-product currency, aggregate QC or campaign completion.

Record 389 represents four separately enriched substrate lines and bacterial V1-V2 amplicon profiles, not a fifteen-stock synthetic community. Prevotella_1 and Prevotella_7 remain separate SILVA bins; YAB2003 and RC9 group names remain narrower than their encoded family descriptors. Generic reference correspondence does not reclassify the source ASVs.

For 389, Selenomonas-to-Centipeda is 278/482 references, Fibrobacter-to-Hallerella is 47/54, and Prevotellaceae-to-Bacteroidaceae is 15757/15757. Rikenellaceae is 31981/32031. Rounded fractions below one are not unanimity, culture abundance or stock confidence. All five ordered Megasphaera alternatives remain without a single block or invented denominator.

The 389 pooled inoculum, G0 versus G1-G10 vessel sizes, 72-hour transfers, three community-level nodes, sole PARTIAL selection-to-phenotype direction, three discussions and prior issue 1767 disposition remain unchanged. Neither member necessity nor hydrogen/methane flux, niche partitioning or interspecies exchange is established by this mapping.

Record 381 retains fifteen distinct bacterial stocks and algal CCAP 646/6. The two Alteromonas stocks remain separate despite sharing a 741/754 generic reference population. The algal NO_GTDB_EQUIVALENT status is unchanged. Sixteen inoculated members, fourteen detected bacteria after the rarity filter, total bacterial density and each stock's equal inoculum share remain separate quantities.

The 381 source names Muricauda/Allomuricauda, Halomonas/Vreelandella and Pseudomonas/Stutzerimonas remain separately qualified. Vreelandella alkaliphila and Vibrio diazotrophicus use species-name fallbacks with totals 3 and 5 at fraction 1.0; these are not exact-ID or stock-genome placements. All ten ordered Stutzerimonas alternatives remain; no candidate identifies stock 23-003.

The 381 primary main-text passages and all fifteen Table S1 stock rows were read from separately retained inputs. The supplement is a retained text projection, not a newly inspected original workbook or fresh extraction. Stock deposits, origins and genome-access statements are not independent assembly placement evidence. No new full-paper, sequence, raw-data or figure-pixel review is claimed.

For 381, conflicting producer attribution under issue 1728, absent detected extracellular B12, unresolved release/export/transfer routes and oxic diazotrophy limitations remain. The four community-level nodes and sole HYPOTHESIZED carbon-to-benefit arrow are preserved without promotion to demonstrated exchange or member-level causation.

Record 482 receives only the Rhodanobacter term's 15/15 generic reference relation. The accessible abstract describes an NMC keystone genus and separately a four-isolate SynCom without exposing its complete stock roster. This correspondence cannot establish a Rhodanobacter isolate's membership in that SynCom. Both existing Burkholderia and Achromobacter blocks remain unchanged.

The prior full-record partial assessment for 482 remains needs_curation with scientific_review:false. Issues 2404, 2405 and 2406 remain unresolved: NMC-to-SynCom performance attribution, four-stock roster/complex collapse, and unsupported mechanisms. The abstract's 97.27/68.00/22.91 percent results belong to the glucose-amended NMC experiment. Preserving current biological assertions does not endorse their accuracy.

The pinned crosswalk is 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd; its upstream release and chronology are unestablished. NCBI identity/rank evidence uses observed database identity/stat, not a whole-database checksum. Public metadata includes lookup-row hashes; complete native lookup rows remain captured private source inputs.

Source binding for these three units ran locally at 308081 with Python 3.13.12. Actual M5 staging, application and native gates ran at frozen 308081a8cf3f82472c542db87e135a5b96da61be with Python 3.13.2 and history provider 23899092a4a2aedf53ff4435c0bdc03ebd79e6be. These are working-tree executions with applied canonicals. The retained whole-route 441 preimage is historical and excluded from each later unit's captured input paths; the binder was not rerun after 441 changed.

Native terms reports Validation passed without an assertion denominator. Complete saved-pair persistence, immutable captured-input checkpoints, public proof export and strict caller admission remain separately verified steps. Current biological predicates and the original batch 96/88/133 ledgers must remain enforceable; historical projections may cover only authenticated old byte/event expectations. Other successor chains and the separately maintained 471 composite must be preserved during integration.
